This is last episode of our Singapore series, after watching this video you will get good idea about how to plan this journey.
Date of this particular video shoot- 7th July
Singapore visa - High commission of singapore does not give direct visa to tourists, they route it through agencies, i paid 3500 for the visa through an agency which is based out of karol bagh, New Delhi. Each city has such agents who are official representative of singapore high commission.
Started from - Siloso Beach about 3 km from VivoCity Singapore.
Tourists can travel from VivoCity to Sentosa by cable car or by road.
